<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py: Claude pt-BR terminology -->
In pt-BR UI copy and responses, translate these terms exactly as listed:

- Claude Code → Claude Code. Product name. Keep in English in every language, without quotation marks.
- Cowork → Cowork. Product name. Keep in English.
- Remote Control → Remote Control. Keep in English when capitalized as the feature name. Translate lowercase “remote control” used descriptively.
- MCP / MCP server → MCP. Keep the abbreviation MCP; translate “server”.
- desktop app → aplicativo para desktop. Keep Claude Desktop and Claude Code for Desktop in English when used as names.
- Dispatch → Dispatch. Keep Dispatch in English as the feature name and on toggles. zh-Hans translates the verb as 派发.
- Session → sessão / sessões. A unit of work in Claude Code and Cowork. zh-Hans: session = 会话, chat and conversation = 对话; never mix them.
- Chat / Conversation → conversa. zh-Hans uses 对话 for both chat and conversation, never 聊天. ja-JP and ko-KR: chat = チャット / 채팅, conversation = 会話 / 대화.
- Side Chat → chat lateral
- Skill → habilidade. zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep Skill in English, never 技能. ja-JP uses the plural Skills.
- Artifact → artefato. Handled differently per language: zh-Hans keeps Artifact, zh-Hant uses 成品, ja-JP keeps Artifacts, ko-KR transliterates as 아티팩트.
- Extension → extensão / extensões. Distinct from Plugin. zh-Hans: Extension = 扩展, Plugin = 插件; never use 插件 for Extension.
- Computer use → uso do computador. zh-Hans mostly uses 计算机使用: 21 against 2 for 电脑操作.
- Quick Entry → Quick Entry. Translated in menus and settings; some web strings still keep Quick Entry.
- Developer / Developer mode → modo de desenvolvedor
- Project → projeto
- Memory → memória. Claude’s memory feature. Hardware memory is a different word, e.g. zh-Hans 内存.
- Connector → conector
- Plugin → plugin. Distinct from Extension. zh-Hans: Plugin = 插件, Extension = 扩展.
- Message → mensagem
- Incognito → anônimo
- Style → estilo. zh-Hans: Claude’s response style = 风格, output style = 输出风格. Official copy uses 样式 for creating custom styles about half the time.
- Routine → rotina. zh-Hans mixes 例程 and 例行任务; 例程 is the majority.
- Scheduled task → tarefa agendada / tarefas agendadas
- Integration → integração / integrações
- Voice mode → modo de voz
- Knowledge (project knowledge) → conhecimento
- Model → modelo. Never translate model names such as Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- Agent → agente. zh-Hans: AI agent = 智能体, never 代理. 代理 is used only for system components such as the SSH agent.
- Research → pesquisa
- Thinking / Extended thinking → pensando
- Prompt → prompt
- Context / Context window → contexto
- Token → token. As an LLM unit, keep lowercase token, e.g. zh-Hans “{count} 个 token”. Authentication tokens are translated, e.g. zh-Hans 令牌.
- Compact → compactar
- Tool → ferramenta
- Web search → pesquisa na web
- Plan mode → modo de planejamento
- Auto mode → modo automático
- Sandbox → sandbox
- Folder → pasta. ja-JP mixes フォルダ and フォルダー; フォルダ is the majority. Translate directory separately, e.g. zh-Hans 目录.
- Workspace → workspace
- Repository → repositório
- Worktree → worktree. The git worktree concept.
- Git origin → origem do Git. Official translations are inconsistent; the recommendation follows the majority.
- Branch → branch
- Pull request → pull request
- Sign in / Log in → fazer login. ja-JP keeps the distinction: sign in = サインイン, log in = ログイン.
- Organization / Admin → organização
- Credentials → credenciais
- Permission → permissão
- API key → chave de API
- Plan → plano. The subscription tier, such as Pro or Max. Distinct from plan mode, e.g. zh-Hans 套餐 versus 计划模式.
- Usage / Usage limits → uso
- Upgrade → fazer upgrade
- Subscription → assinatura
- Seat → assento
- Rate limit → limite de taxa / limites de taxa
- Pin / Pinned → fixar. Pinning an item to the top of a list: zh-Hans 置顶, zh-Hant 釘選, ja-JP ピン留め. Locking a setting, such as a Git origin: zh-Hans 固定.
- Trust / Trusted → confiar. trusted folder = zh-Hans 受信任的文件夹.
- Allow / Allowed → permitir
- Approve / Approved → aprovar
- Fork → fork
- Star / Starred → favoritar
- Archive → arquivar. An archive file format is a different term, e.g. zh-Hans 压缩文件.
- Share → compartilhar. zh-Hans: 共享 for ongoing access, such as sharing a project or plugin; 分享 for sending content, such as sharing a chat or Skill.
- Attach / Attachment → anexar
- this computer → computador. zh-Hans splits 计算机 and 电脑 almost evenly; 计算机 appears mostly with Computer use. Use 电脑 for the device.
- Phone → celular
- Cloud → nuvem. Keep names such as Google Cloud.
- Settings → configurações
- Configuration / Config → configuração. zh-Hans distinguishes settings = 设置 and config = 配置.
- Window → janela
- Terminal → terminal
- Connect / Connected / Connection → conectar / conexão
- Restart → reiniciar. ko-KR mostly uses 다시 시작, sometimes 재시작.
- Update → atualizar. ja-JP uses 更新 in general and アップデート mainly for app version updates.
- Debug / Log → logs. zh-Hant mixes 偵錯 and 除錯; 偵錯 is the majority.
- Dictation → ditado
